metadata.description: A 9-step process for writing lead-generating LinkedIn posts in the writer's own voice — idea to publish-ready, with aggressive formatting baked in.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-writing
plugins.description: Turns ONE idea into a publish-ready LinkedIn post via a 9-step pipeline (post type → format → angle → meat → body → trailer → humanize → layout). Voice, audience, and language are the user's inputs, so it writes in their voice — not a generic copywriter voice. Self-contained; aggressive formatting and anti-AI humanize rules ship inside.
